scope: Gemma4 generative OCR, shared Apple M4 Max 32 GPU cores/36 GiB. Recognition includes image prep/prefill/decode/HTTP; rendering/startup excluded. All diagnostics excluded from throughput qualification. Model/assistant pins in gemma4-ocr-clustered-head.json.

canonical_prefix_step_diagnostic.scope: Canonical singleton rewrites current KV and emits its choice after each matrix comparison, restoring canonical history for the next step. Whole decoder comparison; local layer restoration disabled. All checked head choices match their captured normalized hidden head.

smallest_canonical_margin.meaning: newline versus EOS at a paragraph boundary; IDs are for the pinned tokenizer. Margin is raw logits before any monotonic softcap.

interpretation: No choice divergence in 7800 identical-state full-step comparisons across two passes. Earlier free-running matrix control intermittently omits 41 tokens at a paragraph boundary. Local projections differ in float arithmetic, but normalization matches in the isolated probe. Accumulated state and cohort scheduling geometry remain suspects; not a proven KV or norm implementation bug. EOS-only confirmation does not repair past state.

overall_decision.reason: Four-row/eight-window canonical QKV beats ordinary in transcript-matching bracketed campaigns, but its later allocation-instrumented run omits Attention page 6. The matrix parity failure remains unresolved. No overall MTP speedup qualifies. All experiments remain opt-in.
